name: Advance Metering Technology Limited
about: Advance Metering Technology Limited engages in energy generation, measurement, and management through renewable sources in India. It operates through the Power Generation, Investments, and Meter and Others segments. The company is involved in wind power generation through windmills and other renewable energy sources, as well as the manufacture and sale of energy meters. It also provides technical consultancy services related to the energy sector, rental services, installation services, and estate management services, as well as engineering, procurement, and construction work services. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is based in Noida, India.
